description: Get your seller balance in USD: money on hold (buyer-protection period or disputed), being sent, waiting for the crypto payout minimum and already paid out, plus the next release date, where payouts go, and every past payout with its transaction ID. Use get_sales for the individual sales behind these totals, get_stats for views and clicks over time, and set_payout_wallet to change where money is sent. Needs your API key.

api_key.description: Your iamai.markets API key (iam_…). Only needed if your MCP client cannot send an Authorization header.

name: get_balance
title: Balance & payouts
